verdict.rationale: Headless or CI operation is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, for example a headless host or a CLI-driven client, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Parsec running headlessly or inside CI pipelines. The Teams API automates deployment, provisioning and audit reporting, which is an admin-management API rather than headless execution of the product. Virtual monitors are an adjacent display feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
